profile.headline: Software Engineer ll @ Cisco
profile.summary: Hi! My experience as a Software Engineer at a large corporation has allowed me to learn the importance of maintaining a resilient & loosely coupled architecture when it comes to working with large data sets. During my time I've partnered with other teams to create the right solution for customers & ensure we realize continuous improvements every release cycle by using Agile methodology. This exposure allows me to continuously bring new ideas for product innovation and improve the software development processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll, Digital Enterprise Solutions
positions.description:
• Tools Used: Mule 4, Splunk, Oracle SQL Developer, Webex Suite, Jira, Rapid7
• Work across multiple time zones - Pacific, Eastern, India Standard Time
• Upgrade our APIs to leverage the latest MuleSoft version/features (With a focus on writing clean code!)
• Migrate our applications to use Okta when authenticating & authorizing clients
• Enable a Disaster Recovery plan through an Active-Passive architecture
• Collaborate & coordinate with other teams on project timelines
• Create technical design documentation to be used by the team as well as contributing to user documentation to be used by end users
• Debug and address software issues during development and in production systems to support customers
• Standardize applications logs to track requests across different systems
• Refactor & Deprecate existing projects to ensure clients are using the latest applications
• Conduct Interviews & help Onboard new hires
• Remediate any findings from our Vulnerability Assessments

positions.title: Software Engineer, CX
positions.description:
• Tools Used: Mule 3, SourceTree, Postman, Apache JMeter, Maven
• Develop solutions to allow our department to leverage customer data throughout different systems
• Follow secure coding practices to ensure we maintain user privacy
• Utilize MuleSoft to connect with a variety of technologies such as Kafka, Oracle, Elasticsearch, etc.  
• Build proxies to externalize internal APIs (Secured with Oauth 2.0) 
• Create oData service to dynamically query a data source (Snowflake)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Technologies used: Kafka, Zookeeper, Cassandra, Java, Git, JUnit testing, Docker
• Worked remotely with team members from India to discuss project details and progression
• Create more efficient API calls by tracking changes done to the main database and storing them into a      Cassandra database to track updated data

positions.title: Camp Instructor
positions.description:
• Coordinated lectures to introduce coding to young children 
• Worked with Unity and GameSalad to create virtual games
• Managed classroom equipment such as laptops and smartphones

positions.title: Laborer
positions.description:
• Communicated with employer to update him on progress of multiple job sites
• Assisted in managing inventory of supplies

honors.title: Koret Fellow
honors.description: Fellowship to participate in an immersion in Mexico to gain a better understanding of simple living. Also, had the opportunity to work alongside rural communities and learn about current immigration issues in North America.
honors.issuer: Issued by LEAD Scholars Program · Nov 2019

honors.title: PG&E Scholar
honors.description: Awarded the “Latinos in STEM” scholarship. Also, was able to participate in the PG&E Scholar Summit where I was able to network with PG&E staff and tour their facilities.
honors.issuer: Issued by Pacific Gas and Electric Company · Jul 2016

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Cristo Rey San José Jesuit High School & Corporate Work Study Program
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Meet with a small group of 10th grade students for an hour a week to discuss topics that prepare them     for life after high school
- These topics include Resume Reviews, Job Searching, LinkedIn Profiles, etc.

company.name: Cristo Rey San José Jesuit High School & Corporate Work Study Program

volunteerExperiences.description: My university hosted this 24 hour hackathon. The theme of this event was to develop something that would help an individual or a community in case of a natural disaster. My team and I decided to create an educational application that would inform the user what should be done in case of different emergency situations such as a fire or an earthquake.

organizations.name: LEAD Scholars Program
organizations.description: Program designated to help first-generation college students with their transition to university. Through LEAD I am able to engage with the community and mentor students who also wish to become first-generation college students.

organizations.name: Theta Tau, Professional Engineering Fraternity
organizations.description: Theta Tau seeks to develop and maintain a high standard of professional interest among its members and to unite them in a strong bond of fraternal fellowship.
